department.value: Department of Women Development and Social Welfare
department.evidence: This scheme is administered under the Department of Women Development and Social Welfare.

benefits.evidence: approved beneficiaries will receive a one-time financial benefit of ₹50,000 directly credited via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)

structured.conditions: to support micro-enterprise capitalization and raw material procurement

eligibility_conditions.value: Female individual aged 21-55, state resident for 3 years, annual family income <= ₹3,00,000
eligibility_conditions.evidence: female individual aged between 21 and 55 years at the date of application

required_documents.value: Aadhaar Card, Proof of Residence, Udyam Registration Certificate, Bank Passbook copy
required_documents.evidence: Valid Aadhaar Card for proof of identity and biometric verification

application_procedure.value: Submit application online via official state welfare citizen service portal with Aadhaar OTP authentication
application_procedure.evidence: Eligible applicants must submit applications online via the official state welfare citizen service portal.

deadline.evidence: The deadline for receipt of applications for the current fiscal cycle is 2026-12-31 at 23:59 hours IST.

official_link.evidence: The official portal link for electronic registration is: https://example-state-portal.gov.invalid/schemes/women-entrepreneurship

department.evidence: यह योजना राज्य के कुटीर एवं ग्रामोद्योग विभाग द्वारा संचालित की जा रही है।

benefits.evidence: पात्र कारीगरों को टूलकिट एवं कार्यशील पूंजी हेतु ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त वित्तीय अनुदान सहायता बैंक खाते में प्रदान की जाएगी।

eligibility_conditions.value: राज्य का मूल निवासी, आयु 18 से 60 वर्ष, पारंपरिक ग्रामीण हस्तशिल्प सक्रिय कारीगर
eligibility_conditions.evidence: आवेदक की आयु 18 वर्ष से 60 वर्ष के मध्य होनी चाहिए।

required_documents.value: आधार कार्ड, राज्य निवास प्रमाण पत्र, बैंक पासबुक, हस्तशिल्पी कारीगर पहचान पत्र

application_procedure.value: ग्राम पंचायत अथवा जिला उद्योग केंद्र (DIC) में भौतिक आवेदन अथवा ऑनलाइन ई-मित्र पोर्टल
application_procedure.evidence: ग्राम पंचायत कार्यालय अथवा जिला उद्योग केंद्र (DIC) में निर्धारित प्रारूप में भौतिक आवेदन पत्र जमा कर सकते हैं

deadline.evidence: योजना में पंजीकरण करने की अंतिम तिथि 31 मार्च 2027 निर्धारित की गई है।

official_link.evidence: विभागीय आधिकारिक सूचना एवं पोर्टल लिंक: https://example-state-gramudyog.gov.invalid/schemes/rural-handicraft

scheme_name.value: Krishi Protsahan & High-Yield Seed Support Initiative
scheme_name.evidence: KRISHI PROTSAHAN & HIGH-YIELD SEED SUPPORT INITIATIVE

department.evidence: administered directly by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer Empowerment.

benefits.evidence: annual financial assistance of Rs 12,000 for purchasing certified high-yield seeds and bio-fertilizers

structured.conditions: purchasing certified high-yield seeds and bio-fertilizers

eligibility_conditions.value: Resident farmer owning < 2 hectares agricultural land, Kisan Credit Card and bank account seeded with Aadhaar
eligibility_conditions.evidence: owning cultivable agricultural land of less than 2 hectares.

required_documents.value: Land Record Patta / RoR certificate, Aadhaar Card copy, Bank Passbook, self-declaration
required_documents.evidence: Land Record Patta / RoR certificate, Aadhaar Card copy, Bank Passbook

application_procedure.value: Submit physical form at Block Agriculture Office or Common Service Centre (CSC)
application_procedure.evidence: submitted in physical form at the local Block Agriculture Office or via the Common Service Centre

deadline.evidence: strict deadline for submitting applications for the Kharif cycle is 2026-11-30.

source_1.evidence_text: approved beneficiaries will receive a one-time financial benefit of ₹50,000 directly credited via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)

source_2.evidence_text: Beneficiaries under this listing are eligible for a one-time grant assistance of Rs 40,000 for seed venture setup.
